description: United Rentals is the largest equipment rental company in the world, operates throughout the United States and Canada, and has a smaller presence in Europe, Australia and New Zealand, and for the year ended December 31, 2025 it reported total revenues of $16,099 million, with equipment rental revenue representing 86 percent of total revenues, total equipment rental revenue variance of 6.0%, key account revenue of 69 percent and national account revenue of 46 percent of equipment rental revenue.
